conversation.text: You said your training left you poorly prepared. What is happening?

My training was just a single slide deck and my buddy has been too busy with month-end, so I had to learn invoice posting from YouTube. A two-hour hands-on SAP session with real cases would really help, especially since I had to reverse three invoices last week after posting them to the wrong cost centre.

Here is what I will tell HR: The onboarding training consisted of a single slide deck, and self-directed learning was required for invoice posting tasks.
